name: Edgar Degas
findings: Within his own canvases, deep champagne turns up as a small accent in 43% of the paintings that hold it, 3.8x the archive's rate (from 753 paintings here).
Within his own canvases, antique green turns up as the lightest note in 50% of the paintings that hold it, 4.5x the archive's rate (from 753 paintings here).
Within his own canvases, taupe grey turns up as the shadow in 57% of the paintings that hold it, 4.7x the archive's rate (from 753 paintings here).
Rarely uses smoky black, common in the same museum(s)' other paintings (from 753 paintings here).
Pairs ghost white with lavender grey more than chance would predict (3 of 753 paintings here).
Pairs black bean with dark sienna more than chance would predict (3 of 753 paintings here).
His single largest palette family (putty, smoky black, dark olive brown) covers 42% of his paintings here.
